description: This file is a shell script that sets up, performs, and verifies git operations related to handling criss-cross renames and applying diffs. It includes functions to create files, run tests to simulate renaming files in a criss-cross pattern, generate diffs with specific options, and apply these diffs to verify correct behavior.

methods.name: create_file
methods.description: Creates a file with specified name and content, repeated multiple times.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files for content equality.
